text:
The Companion Animal Travel Desk has read the complaint carefully and is treating it with urgency. We understand that the issue involved a missed expectation around pet handling and the distress this caused for the traveler and the animal.

We are sorry for the disruption and for the concern this created during travel. Your complaint makes clear that the care promised was not matched by the experience delivered, and that is not acceptable. We are reviewing the handling of the case from check-in through arrival so we can identify where the process broke down and what support should follow next.

We also want to address the matter of the missing crate. <<FACT F118>> If the crate is still unlocated, we will continue to press for a documented search and a prompt claim review through the proper channel. The traveler should keep all available records tied to the journey, including tags, receipts, and any written notices received at the airport. If there were any delays in communication, we will flag those for immediate review.

If the complaint also concerns the pet's comfort, safety, or transfer between staff teams, we are escalating that part of the file as well. The current review will include the handling notes, handoff steps, and any follow-up that should have been given sooner. We want to be clear that a calm stepwise review is now in progress, and the goal is a full account, not a rushed answer.

Aurelia Skyways expects every animal to be treated with care, and every traveler to receive timely support when something goes wrong. We are asking the case team to move this forward without delay and to provide a direct update as soon as the review is complete. If additional action is needed, it will be handled through the proper support path.

We regret the stress this has caused and will continue working to resolve it properly.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
